text:
maria: Noticed noisy behavior from gw-03 affecting tenant creative-ai on dedicated-grid-eu-west. p99 egress jumps and a couple of alloc preempts. No obvious GPU mem pressure. Anyone seeing similar?

raj: saw the spike too. routing table for those allocs shows tag:egress=dedicated-eu but policy matched egress-route-v2 -> fallback path. Can you grab the route snapshot?

ops-bot: MONITOR: egress-queue-depth anomaly on gw-03 (rack42) at 2025-01-12T01:12:10Z. auto-ticket INC-8124 created.

maria: route dump: `routes.20250112.json` attached in incident. snippet: `tenant=creative-ai -> selector(tag:egress==dedicated-eu) -> match fail -> apply default=shared-proxy`

sophie: that match fail smells like policy indexing bug after kevin's rollout. v2 introduced prefix matching change.

kevin: I rolled egress-route-v2 at 00:50 for eu regions. If v2 uses prefix instead of exact tag that could cause mismatch. rolling back v2 on eu now.

kevin: rollback cmd: `infractl routes apply --file /ops/egress-route-v1.yaml --region eu-west`

raj: meanwhile I'm shifting VIP traffic away from gw-03 to gw-04 to reduce queue backlog. running `conntrack` drain and ephemeral redirect.

maria: quick cost question @amy: if we migrate these allocs to the shared pool for ~4h while root-cause is validated, what's the rough delta?

amy: migrating to shared increases estimated spend for creative-ai ~20% over that window but avoids SLO breaches. Also flag: shared pool has lower isolation risk for noisy-KV eviction.

nate: FYI I see NIC tx-queue buildups on gw-03 correlated with egress route switch. `ethtool -S` shows tx_packets spiking. Might be packetization mismatch to the shim.

maria: action plan: 1) rollback v2 in eu (kevin) 2) drain gw-03 to gw-04 (raj) 3) temporary shared-pool migration if rollback doesn't stabilize in 15m (maria/amy) 4) CI dry-run for tag semantics (sophie) 5) postmortem if similar recurs.

ops-bot: CHANGE: rollback applied (egress-route-v1) in eu-west at 2025-01-12T01:25:03Z.

kevin: metrics: infra.egress.tail_p99{pool="dedicated-grid-eu-west"} down from 420ms -> 32ms in the 10m post-rollback window. No new preempts.

maria: gw-03 drain completed. queue depths normalized. I'm holding off on shared migration.

sophie: I'll open PR to add an automated route dry-run that checks tag equality vs prefix semantics against a small canary tenant. Also adding a lint that fails rollout if selector type changes.

nate: recommend we add a lightweight telemetry counter `routing.selector_mismatch_total` to catch this class proactively.

maria: agreed. I'll create the incident timeline and schedule a 30m follow-up war room in 1h to validate logs and telemetry. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
